posts.body_html:
Once again I am extremely impressed with my order from Calen - not only can I add some of the best plants around to my collection (where else are you going to get Outlaw and Super Heavy Veins?!) but I can get them at the best price around - and best of all, you will get top notch size and quality. His "large" is an understatement - I've had established plants in my collection for 4 years that aren't even half the size Calen sells his large plants for! I highly recommend ordering from Calen - unless you plan on ordering something I'm eyeing up for next time 

Untitled by Adam G, on Flickr

Select Dark #2 - remember, this is a size "small/medium" - there are at least 4 growth points there.

Untitled by Adam G, on Flickr

and finally, a freebie - flava (cuprea BH x Black Veins Damon's Clone). This freebie (thanks again Calen!) is bigger than half of the plants I bought!

Untitled by Adam G, on Flickr

Today I was blessed by the Sarracenia Gods to get an absolute SCORE in the mail from Calen!! After trading emails with him about a project I'm working on for some friends, Calen HOOKED ME UP with some of the largest plants I've received. This was a split order between me and one of my good friends' grandparents, I told Calen I was looking for some large plants to get them started off right and once again, he crushed it!

Despite our local post office doing their best to rough up the plants, they arrived in great shape due to Calen's packing skills


Some real big boy rhizomes on these








LOOK AT THOSE PHYLLODIA


My favorite thing about Calen's plants - the roots are ALWAYS ridiculous!


All potted up and ready for action!

posts.body_html:
Just placed an order for some of Calen's plants and can't wait for them to arrive!

1. ornata (Gulf Coast x Black Veins Clone B) Select Dark #1 - similar to above but a bit taller growing, a gorgeous ornata

2. S. x excellens Giant (minor okeefenokeensis Phil's Giant x leuco Purple Lips) Select Clone - one of the two largest and most vigorous clones from the seed batch - very robust traps!

3. rugelii (AxB)#1 - large, robust, vigorous clone, solid blotch, can’t go wrong!

4. S. x moorei (Hot Lips x Legacy) - extreme diversity in this complex cross, but I can say there is not a single ugly plant! Lots of gorgeous whites, pinks, and blotches

Still tons of amazing stuff available on the list guys and gals. Nobody likes flavas this time of year lol but the flava sections are particularly dense with gems. Location leucos are ramping up too!
They are gorgeous, coming from someone that bought so many this time, he had two packages.   Even the ones that went on an extended stay in Memphis courtesy of USPS   look great. 




Thankfully Calen packs them well and they are settling in and beginning to push out new growth.  Really been liking buying some plants this time of year, riskier shipping, but they get some time to settle in before winter and a bit more chance of having some good performances next year.
